detecção de shinys, megas e bosses
menos de R$ 9 por dia (R$ 250 ÷ 30 = R$ 8,33)

notes: Compares only with playing by hand ('NA MÃO'), never with other bots or brands. Dropped the concept's 6th row 'Acompanha pelo celular': the ✗ for manual play isn't cleanly factual (and five rows read better on the beat). The '0 × 5' scoreboard only counts the five rows shown. Price beat: 'E o preço?' + drumroll → 'menos de R$ 9 por dia' with 'planos a partir de R$ 250 por mês' under it; no de/por, no urgency. No LINK NA BIO bar in this episode (the board needs the space); the CTA is the end-card question (the pinned question as a question). Full-screen broadcast framing (rounded CRT vignette + scanlines + AO VIVO bug) on a yellow studio, so it differs from 121–123.
